bundle.shortDescription: Your documents, sealed on your phone and opened only by you
bundle.longDescription: HumID keeps personal documents in a zero-knowledge vault. Everything is sealed on the device with ML-KEM-1024 + X25519 and signed with ML-DSA-87, and every open, save or delete needs a live biometric check.
